name: 4Ls (Loved, Learned, Loathed, Longed For)
trigger: Milestone or sprint reviews within engineering teams requiring a balanced evaluation of intellectual growth, product value, and operational friction.
canvas: 4 Quadrants: Loved, Learned, Loathed, Longed For
canvasLine: 4 Quadrants: Loved, Learned, Loathed, Longed For · 60–75 min

steps.text: Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive; Loathed targets tooling, never a colleague.
Gather data (20m): two notes each into Loved, Learned, Loathed, Longed For.
Generate insights (20m): pair each Loathed with the Longed For that removes it.
Decide (20m): the strongest pairs become backlog experiments with owners.
Close (5m): name what the Learned notes give back.

action: Loathed manual tagging plus Longed For automated releases becomes one release action.
provenance: Source protocol: the phases and minutes follow the written sequence in the source.

origin.note: A common agile format; no documented originator.
